mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.09% is historically low, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index exceeds 225, it signals persistent inflation, prompting market fears of aggressive monetary tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL > 225 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) signals an economic policy dilemma, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 500, it indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods with HOUST > 500 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE < 5.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods where PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising residential sales (RSAFS) indicate overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with rising RSAFS are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 95, it indicates robust supply conditions, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods with INDPRO > 95 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
